title: Pemdi Aceh Tengah
tagline: Kokpit pemdi & dasbor transparansi untuk kabupaten di dataran tinggi Gayo.
problem: Informasi layanan publik kabupaten tersebar di banyak tempat dan sulit dijangkau warga — portal resmi membutuhkan infrastruktur berbayar dan alur konten yang berat untuk dioperasikan satu orang. September 2026, kebutuhan berubah lagi: pengelolaan 250 butir bukti dukung SPBE menjadi prioritas, sementara transparansi publik tetap harus terlayani.

approach.title: Static-first, deploy gratis
approach.text: Seluruh halaman dirender statis lalu di-host di Vercel — biaya nol, waktu muat cepat, dan tahan lonjakan trafik saat momen layanan ramai (penerimaan, cut bersama).

approach.title: Konten terstruktur in-repo
approach.text: Konten hidup sebagai berkas dalam repositori — perubahan lewat git, terlacak siapa mengubah apa, bisa dikoreksi siapa saja lewat pull request.

approach.title: Reposisi Opsi B (Sep 2026)
approach.text: Arah produk digeser terbuka: kokpit pemdi internal untuk mengelola 250 butir bukti dukung, dasbor transparansi publik, dan komponen yang siap terintegrasi ke Alpukat Gayo — infrastruktur lama dipertahankan, bukan dibangun ulang.

outcome: Pivot yang terdokumentasi di depan umum: kebutuhan nyata pemda didahulukan tanpa membuang fondasi yang sudah terbukti — pola "reposisi tanpa membangun ulang dari nol" yang bisa direplikasi pemerintah daerah lain.

en.tagline: A government cockpit & transparency dashboard for a highland Gayo regency.
en.problem: Public service information was scattered and hard for residents to reach, and an official portal would require paid infrastructure and a heavy workflow for a one-person team. By September 2026 the need shifted again: managing 250 SPBE supporting-evidence items became the priority, while public transparency still had to be served.

approach.title: Static-first, free deploys
approach.text: Every page is rendered statically and hosted on Vercel — zero cost, fast loads, and resilient to traffic spikes during busy service seasons.

approach.title: Structured content in-repo
approach.text: Content lives as files in the repository — changes go through git, tracked and correctable by anyone via pull request.

approach.title: Repositioning, option B (Sep 2026)
approach.text: The product direction shifted in the open: an internal government cockpit managing 250 supporting-evidence items, a public transparency dashboard, and components ready to integrate into Alpukat Gayo — the existing foundation is kept, not rebuilt.

en.outcome: A pivot documented in public: real government needs come first without throwing away a proven foundation — a "reposition without rebuilding from scratch" pattern other regions can replicate.

title: Flame ADE
tagline: Emulator terminal AI-native ~7 MB — Tauri 2 + Rust + React 19.
problem: Terminal modern dengan AI biasanya membawa Electron (ratusan MB) dan mengunci pengguna ke satu penyedia model. Pengguna menginginkan terminal yang punya "otak" tapi tetap ringan, cepat, dan tidak memaksa langganan.

approach.title: Tauri, bukan Electron
approach.text: Shell desktop ditulis Rust dengan WebView sistem — hasilnya binary ±7 MB dan konsumsi memori orde lebih kecil dibanding Electron.

approach.title: AI sebagai fitur, bukan kandungan
approach.text: Bring-your-own-key: pengguna menempel kunci model pilihannya (lokal atau cloud) — terminal tidak pernah mengirim data ke server siapa pun selain milik pengguna sendiri.

approach.title: UI React 19 di atas core Rust
approach.text: Pengalaman antarmuka modern (React 19 + TypeScript) tanpa mengorbankan kecepatan proses inti yang tetap di sisi Rust.

outcome: Terminal AI-native yang benar-benar seukuran notepad — target utama macOS Tahoe, dengan disiplin ukuran yang dijaga sejak commit pertama. Bukti bahwa "AI di mana-mana" tidak harus berarti "berat di mana-mana".

en.tagline: An AI-native terminal emulator ~7 MB — Tauri 2 + Rust + React 19.
en.problem: Modern AI terminals usually ship Electron (hundreds of MB) and lock users to a single model provider. People want a terminal with a "brain" that stays light, fast, and free of forced subscriptions.

approach.title: Tauri, not Electron
approach.text: The desktop shell is written in Rust with the system WebView — resulting in a ±7 MB binary and an order of magnitude lower memory use than Electron.

approach.title: AI as a feature, not baggage
approach.text: Bring-your-own-key: users plug in the model key of their choice (local or cloud) — the terminal never sends data to anyone's server but their own.

approach.title: React 19 UI over a Rust core
approach.text: A modern interface experience (React 19 + TypeScript) without sacrificing the speed of core processes that stay on the Rust side.

en.outcome: An AI-native terminal genuinely the size of a text file — primarily targeting macOS Tahoe, with size discipline enforced since the first commit. Proof that "AI everywhere" doesn't have to mean "heavy everywhere".

title: AI First OS
tagline: Arch Linux ISO builder dengan Hermes Agent sebagai warga kelas satu.
problem: Distribusi Linux umum memperlakukan AI sebagai aplikasi tambahan yang dipasang belakangan. Bagaimana jika OS dibangun dari ISO dengan agen AI sebagai "warga negara kelas satu" — tersedia sejak boot pertama, bukan setelah setup manual berjam-jam?

approach.title: ISO builder ter-skrip penuh
approach.text: Seluruh proses build ISO ditulis dalam skrip shell yang bisa diaudit — tidak ada sihir GUI; hasil build reproducible dan bisa dijalankan CI.

approach.title: Hermes sejak boot
approach.text: Agen Hermes terintegrasi pada tahap image — pengguna langsung punya asisten sistem yang memahami konfigurasi mesinnya sendiri.

approach.title: Ekosistem terorkestrasi
approach.text: Terhubung dengan repo orchestration (AGENTS.md, backlog, pipeline kematangan v4) sehingga evolusi OS, dotfiles, dan tooling berjalan di satu alur kerja.

outcome: Eksperimen sistem operasi AI-first yang reproducible: satu perintah build ISO, agen aktif sejak boot, dan seluruh keputusan arsitektur terdokumentasi terbuka untuk ditelusuri siapa saja.

en.tagline: An Arch Linux ISO builder with Hermes Agent as a first-class citizen.
en.problem: Mainstream Linux distributions treat AI as an afterthought app installed later. What if an OS were built from the ISO up with an AI agent as a "first-class citizen" — available from first boot, not after hours of manual setup?

approach.title: Fully scripted ISO builder
approach.text: The entire ISO build process is written in auditable shell scripts — no GUI magic; builds are reproducible and CI-runnable.

approach.title: Hermes from boot
approach.text: The Hermes agent is integrated at the image stage — users immediately get a system assistant that understands its own machine's configuration.

approach.title: An orchestrated ecosystem
approach.text: Connected to the orchestration repo (AGENTS.md, backlog, v4 maturity pipeline) so the OS, dotfiles, and tooling evolve in one workflow.

en.outcome: A reproducible AI-first OS experiment: one command builds the ISO, the agent is active from boot, and every architectural decision is documented in the open for anyone to trace.

title: Niu Gayo Agro-Climate
tagline: Cuaca presisi untuk kopi Arabika Gayo & mitigasi bencana Aceh Tengah.
problem: Dataran Tinggi Gayo adalah produsen kopi Arabika organik terbesar di Indonesia, tetapi variabilitas iklim mikro dan topografi pegunungan terjal membuat prakiraan cuaca umum tidak cukup: petani perlu panduan melawan karat daun (Hemileia vastatrix), menjemur gabah/green bean dengan presisi radiasi matahari, dan warga perlu peringatan dini longsor lereng perkebunan serta luapan Danau Lut Tawar.

approach.title: Data engine meteorologi resolusi tinggi
approach.text: Integrasi stream meteorologi resolusi tinggi ECMWF / WeatherNext 3 — bukan prakiraan generik, melainkan resolusi spasial yang menangkap iklim mikro pegunungan Gayo.

approach.title: Tiga domain panduan nyata
approach.text: Dari kebun (produktivitas & kualitas specialty coffee) ke pascapanen (penjemuran presisi) hingga keselamatan warga (mitigasi hidrometeorologi) — satu sistem, tiga keputusan yang dibantu.

approach.title: Ringan & teruji
approach.text: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind dengan pengujian native Node runner — proyek cepat dirilis tetap terkawal kualitasnya.

outcome: Sistem informasi cuaca presisi yang menyasar rantai nilai kopi Gayo dari kebun sampai penjemuran, plus lapisan mitigasi bencana untuk warga dataran tinggi — civic tech yang berangkat dari kebutuhan lokal yang sangat spesifik.

en.tagline: Precision weather for Gayo Arabica coffee & disaster mitigation in Aceh Tengah.
en.problem: The Gayo Highlands are Indonesia’s largest organic Arabica coffee producer, yet micro-climate variability and steep mountain terrain make generic forecasts insufficient: farmers need guidance against leaf rust (Hemileia vastatrix), precise solar-radiation timing for drying green beans, and residents need early warning for landslides on plantation slopes and Lake Lut Tawar flooding.

approach.title: High-resolution meteorological data engine
approach.text: Integrates high-resolution ECMWF / WeatherNext 3 streams — not generic forecasts, but spatial resolution that captures the Gayo highlands’ micro-climate.

approach.title: Three real guidance domains
approach.text: From the farm (specialty-coffee productivity and quality) to post-harvest (precision drying) to public safety (hydrometeorological mitigation) — one system supporting three decisions.

approach.title: Light & tested
approach.text: React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind with the native Node test runner — fast to ship, still quality-controlled.

en.outcome: A precision weather information system covering the Gayo coffee value chain from farm to drying, plus a disaster-mitigation layer for highland residents — civic tech born from very specific local needs.
